answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 151188 Country: India Title: Daughter name and Aqiqah Question: Can I keep my daughter name as Adiba Fathima and what is the meaning of this name. And for aqiqah should I first sacrifice the animal then shave the hair or first shave the hair then sacrifice the animal. Answer ID: 151188 Posted on: Aug 29, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 828/767/SD=8/1438) (1) Yes, you may keep the name Abidah Fatimah for your daughter. Fatimah is the name of the daughter of the Holy Prophet Muhammad (may peace and blessings of Allah be upon him), while Abidah means a pious and worshiping lady. (2) It is mustahab to shave the head on the day of Aqiqah, you may shave the head as per your ease whether before the slaughtering the animal or after it. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
